title: Verify deterministic private unresolved-pattern reporting
preconditions: An isolated completed evaluation contains retained no_suggestion outcomes whose fresh compatible projection exercises normalization equivalence, account and direction splits, count ties, amount sums, and below-minimum groups.
steps: Invoke unresolved.report at exact and one-over bounds; replay unchanged semantics with a fresh snapshot ID; inject every retained/projection/rule-set/category/generation/normalization drift and join-accounting failure; inspect durable files, databases, logs, and rule history.
expected: Groups and totals obey exact accounting and deterministic order; semantic replay hashes match; only the explicit success result contains normalized descriptions and aggregate amounts; all failures return no result; no raw report store, rule proposal, activation, preview, apply, or Ledger mutation exists.
cleanup: Remove only the isolated data root.
